decisions.reason: The quote directly states 'The natural history of motor and language regression is used to monitor the efficacy of CNS treatments.' Motor regression is explicitly mentioned as part of the natural history of CLN2 disease, making this a direct observation of a phenotype of CLN2 disease.

The quote directly states 'The natural history of motor and language regression is used to monitor the efficacy of CNS treatments.' Language regression is explicitly mentioned as part of the natural history of CLN2 disease, making this a direct observation of a phenotype of CLN2 disease.

The quote directly states 'ERGs show cone/rod system dysfunction preceded by localised macular ellipsoid zone disruption on OCT from 4.8 years.' The quote explicitly identifies cone/rod system dysfunction as a finding in CLN2 retinopathy (which is established earlier in the abstract as part of CLN2 disease). This is a direct observation of a phenotype.

Macular ellipsoid zone disruption is explicitly identified in the clinical findings of CLN2 disease patients. This is a direct observation of a phenotype.

The quote 'Less is known about CLN2 retinopathy' does not support the relationship. This sentence merely indicates that CLN2 retinopathy exists and that knowledge about it is limited. It does not describe or establish visual decline as a phenotype. The sentence does not provide evidence that visual decline is a phenotype of CLN2 disease.

The quote directly states 'Cone ERGs show a functional deficit before CST thinning in classical disease.' CST (central subfoveal thickness) thinning is explicitly mentioned as an observed finding in CLN2 disease (classical disease). This is a direct observation of a phenotype of CLN2 disease.
